It suggests that the Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight Consumer Discretionary ETF (RSPD) offers lower company-specific risk and better value compared to XLY, despite XLY's better long-term returns. The analysis highlights 10 stocks expected to be cheaper than their peers starting in 2026.

title: Cullinan Associates Inc. Acquires 74,405 Shares of PayPal Holdings, Inc. $PYPL
summary: Cullinan Associates Inc. significantly increased its stake in PayPal Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:PYPL) during the third quarter, purchasing an additional 74,405 shares to own a total of 100,220 shares valued at approximately $6.72 million. Despite this institutional buying, PayPal has seen insider selling from executives and mixed analyst sentiment with some recent downgrades, though the company did beat Q3 earnings and revenue estimates and issued positive FY2025 EPS guidance. The article highlights key positive and negative news impacting PayPal, including partnerships and expansion into AI-driven commerce alongside concerns about competitive pressure and trading significantly below its 52-week high.

title: Dan Ives Predicts Tesla Will Own '80%' Of Robotaxi Market — Says TSLA In His Top 5 List For 2026
summary: Dan Ives of Wedbush Securities reiterates his bullish outlook on Tesla, predicting the company will dominate 80% of the Robotaxi market by 2026. He places Tesla at the top of his personal list of top five stocks for the year, alongside Microsoft, Apple, Palantir, and CrowdStrike. Ives's prediction comes despite Tesla's Robotaxi service missing previous self-imposed deadlines and the strong performance of competitors like Waymo.

title: Elon Musk Says Tesla Will Stop Selling FSD Post Valentine's Day: 'Only Available As A Monthly Subscription'
summary: Elon Musk announced that Tesla will discontinue selling its Full Self-Driving (FSD) service as a one-time purchase after February 14th, making it exclusively available through a monthly subscription. Currently, FSD can be purchased for $8,000 or subscribed to for $99/month. This change aims to potentially boost adoption, with competitor Rivian also offering a subscription model for its autonomous driving technology.

title: Honda Just Unveiled a Solar-Powered Camper You Can Tow With an EV
summary: Honda has unveiled the Base Station Prototype, a compact, modular, and lightweight towable RV designed for comfortable camping. This innovative camper features a fold-down queen futon, an optional solar array, and swappable kitchen or shower modules. While pricing and production details are not yet confirmed, Honda aims to "democratize camping" by offering an accessible solution that can be towed by smaller vehicles, including EVs.

title: Tesla, Inc. $TSLA Position Cut by Bristlecone Advisors LLC
summary: Bristlecone Advisors LLC has reduced its holdings in Tesla by 5.3% in the third quarter, selling 1,215 shares and now owning 21,823 shares valued at $9.705 million. This comes amidst other institutional investors either increasing or decreasing their stakes, with overall institutional ownership at 66.20%. Meanwhile, Tesla insiders, including CFO Vaibhav Taneja and Director Kimbal Musk, have also sold shares, totaling 119,457 shares worth $53.5 million over the past ninety days.

title: Tesla driver-assist system FSD will switch to subscription-only — Musk
summary: Tesla will transition its Full Self-Driving (FSD) driver-assistance system to a subscription-only model, as announced by CEO Elon Musk. This change, effective after February 14, eliminates the significant upfront purchase cost, with subscriptions already available for US$99 a month. The move comes as Tesla faces a sales slump and focuses more on its tech initiatives.

title: Tesla to stop selling FSD software, will only offer subscription, Musk says
summary: Elon Musk announced that Tesla will cease selling its Full Self-Driving (FSD) software after February 14, transitioning to a subscription-only model. Currently, FSD can be purchased for a one-time fee of $8,000 or subscribed to monthly for $99. This move comes as Tesla aims to boost adoption of the FSD service, which, despite its name, requires human supervision.

title: Tesla to offer self-driving software only on monthly basis from Feb 14, Musk says
summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk announced that the company's full self-driving (FSD) software will transition to a monthly subscription-only model starting February 14. Currently, customers can purchase FSD (Supervised) for a one-time payment of $8,000 or subscribe for $99 per month in the U.S. FSD is an assistance system, and the U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is investigating 2.88 million Tesla vehicles equipped with it due to safety concerns.

title: Tesla vai parar de vender software FSD e oferecerá apenas assinatura, diz Musk
summary: Elon Musk anunciou que a Tesla Inc. deixará de vender seu software "Full Self-Driving (FSD)" após 14 de fevereiro, passando a oferecê-lo apenas por meio de assinatura mensal. Essa mudança visa, provavelmente, aumentar a adoção do serviço, que atualmente custa US$ 8.000 ou US$ 99 por mês. O FSD, embora promova recursos de condução automatizada, ainda requer intervenção humana e é uma aposta de Musk para impulsionar o crescimento da Tesla em meio à desaceleração nas vendas de veículos elétricos.

title: EVs Are ‘The End Game,’ GM CEO Mary Barra Says A Day Before Trump's Detroit Visit
summary: General Motors CEO Mary Barra stated that electric vehicles are the "end game" for the company, despite some recent scaling back of EV ambitions due to regulatory changes and the end of tax credits. Her comments were made a day before former President Donald Trump's visit to Detroit, which comes after his administration's policies impacted the EV market. Barra emphasized that while incentives help, the industry will eventually reach an all-EV future and GM may reintroduce hybrids where necessary.

title: Tesla Model Y Emerges As Best-Selling EV In US For 2025 Despite 15% Drop In Q4 Sales — Ford F150 Lightning Edges Out Cybertruck
summary: The Tesla Model Y was the best-selling EV in the US for 2025, despite its Q4 sales dropping 4% compared to 2024, and the Model 3 also saw a significant Q4 decline. Ford's F-150 Lightning outsold the Tesla Cybertruck, becoming the best-selling EV pickup for the year. General Motors showed strong growth in its EV sales, while Rivian's sales declined and Lucid Group's sales increased.

title: Bill Ford: $20 billion EV pivot about ‘recognizing what reality was’
summary: Ford CEO Jim Farley stated that the company is not moving backward on electric vehicles, while Bill Ford commented that the $20 billion EV pivot was about "recognizing what reality was." The article also mentions the F-150 Lightning and its production ending in late 2025.

title: Tesla Inc. (TSLA) Wolfe Research Maintains “Hold” Rating
summary: Wolfe Research has reiterated its "Hold" rating on Tesla (TSLA), citing a balanced risk-reward view despite the company's long-term leadership in EVs. The firm's stance is influenced by concerns over near-term margin pressure due to Tesla prioritizing volume growth and affordability, and intensifying competition in the EV market. Analysts also noted that much of Tesla's long-term potential, including autonomous driving and AI, is already factored into its current share price, with execution risk remaining a key variable.

title: Antero Resources prices $750 million notes offering at 5.40%
summary: Antero Resources Corporation has priced a $750 million offering of senior unsecured notes due 2036 with a 5.40% interest rate, expected to close on January 28, 2026. The natural gas producer plans to use the estimated $743 million net proceeds to partially finance its "HG Acquisition." This move comes as the company's short-term obligations exceed its liquid assets and follows recent strategic acquisition and divestiture activities that led to revised price targets from analysts.

title: Wall Street sends message on Tesla after Nvidia self-driving move
summary: Despite Nvidia's recent push into autonomy at CES 2026, launching its "Alpamayo" open portfolio for self-driving cars, Morgan Stanley maintains that Tesla still holds a significant lead in autonomous driving. Analyst Andrew Percoco believes Tesla's vast real-world data collection from its fleet gives it a distinct "moat" that competitors, including those utilizing Nvidia's tools, cannot quickly match. While Nvidia's advancements are additive and can speed up advanced driving assistance, they do not represent a near-term turning point that would close the gap with Tesla's extensive experience and data advantage.

title: Tesla Makin Santer Dikabarkan Akan Meluncurkan Mobil Listrik Versi Budget alias Lebih Murah
summary: Tesla is increasingly rumored to be launching a more affordable, budget-friendly version of its electric cars, specifically the Model Y Standard Range. The speculation grew after the budget Model Y briefly appeared on Tesla China's website. These cheaper models, expected to be priced around 200,000 yuan (approximately $28,500), are intended to target lower-price segments while leveraging Tesla's established brand reputation.

title: How Do the 2027 BMW iX3 and 2027 Mercedes-Benz GLC With EQ Technology Compare?
summary: The 2027 BMW iX3 and 2027 Mercedes-Benz GLC With EQ Technology, both unveiled at CES 2026, represent distinct approaches to the next generation of electric luxury SUVs. The iX3 prioritizes a "rolling smartphone" experience with its advanced OSX operating system and Panoramic Vision display, focusing on digital architecture and user interaction. In contrast, the GLC EQ offers a more characterful and elegant interior design, an updated MBUX system with an optional Hyperscreen, and a focus on entertainment and productivity apps. While the iX3 leads in charging speed, the GLC EQ offers slightly more horsepower, making the choice dependent on individual priorities for tech versus interior aesthetics.

title: Automobile Manufacturing Stocks Q3 In Review: Autoliv (NYSE:ALV) Vs Peers
summary: This article reviews the Q3 earnings of several automobile manufacturing stocks, including Autoliv (NYSE:ALV), Ford (NYSE:F), Lucid (NASDAQ:LCID), Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA), and General Motors (NYSE:GM). It highlights Autoliv's strong performance, Ford's exceptional quarter, Lucid's disappointing results, Tesla's satisfactory quarter with a revenue beat, and General Motors' incredible quarter. The report emphasizes the high barriers to entry in auto manufacturing but notes the disruption caused by electric vehicles and the varying success of companies in adapting to these changes.

title: Broadcom Stock Just Went Wild: Is AVGO the Next Must-Cop Chip King or Peak Hype?
summary: This article analyzes Broadcom (AVGO) stock, questioning if it's an essential investment in the chip industry or merely overhyped. It positions Broadcom as a less flashy but fundamentally strong player in AI and cloud infrastructure, combining chip manufacturing with enterprise software. The text compares AVGO to competitors like Nvidia and AMD, highlighting Broadcom's cash generation, dividends, and diversified business model as key strengths for long-term investors.

title: Sunrun Solar US Review: Is This the Smartest Way to Go Solar in 2026?
summary: This article reviews Sunrun Solar (US) as a residential solar and battery provider, focusing on its appeal for homeowners seeking low or zero upfront costs through leases and power purchase agreements. It highlights Sunrun's end-to-end service, custom system design, and battery backup options, making it a convenient choice for those who want solar without the complexity of ownership. The review also discusses mixed customer feedback, including praise for stable bills and no-hassle installation, alongside criticism regarding complex contracts and customer service variability, advising potential customers to carefully compare Sunrun with other options.

title: Tesla Reintroduces Third-Row Seat in Model Y
summary: Tesla has brought back the third-row seat option for its Model Y, specifically for the all-wheel-drive Premium trim, which is a $2,500 add-on. This reintroduction addresses a feature that was removed during the Model Y's refresh last year. Despite the added cost, the Model Y remains the most affordable three-row electric vehicle available, now capable of seating up to seven occupants.

title: Strive Secures Landmark Approval for Semler Scientific Acquisition, Skyrocketing Bitcoin Holdings to 12,798 BTC
summary: U.S. asset manager Strive has received shareholder approval to acquire Semler Scientific, a Nasdaq-listed medical technology firm. This acquisition will increase Strive's Bitcoin holdings from 7,750 BTC to 12,798 BTC, making it one of the largest corporate crypto acquisitions of the year. The move highlights a growing trend of traditional finance entities using strategic mergers to gain exposure to digital assets and solidifies Bitcoin's role as a legitimate treasury asset.

title: If You Own Lucid Stock, Take a Look at This Durable Stock Instead
summary: This article suggests that investors holding Lucid (LCID) stock should consider selling it due to the company's struggles with EV headwinds and declining value. Instead, the author recommends investing in Walmart (WMT), highlighting its steady growth, market durability, and strong financial performance as a safer and more reliable alternative for long-term returns. Walmart's vast retail presence and ability to weather economic slowdowns are presented as key advantages over Lucid's speculative nature.

title: Trump visits a Ford pickup truck factory, aiming to promote his efforts to boost manufacturing
summary: President Donald Trump visited a Ford F-150 factory in Michigan to highlight his administration's efforts to boost U.S. manufacturing and address concerns about the economy. This visit was part of a series of trips to swing states aimed at promoting his economic policies, despite recent Republican losses in off-year elections and persistent public concerns about inflation. Trump discussed tariffs, trade agreements, and recent positive inflation data, while critics, including Michigan Democrats, accused him of promoting a "billionaire-first agenda."

title: Want to Buy Some of the Best Marijuana Stocks for 2026? Consider This ETF.
summary: The article discusses the AdvisorShares Pure US Cannabis ETF (MSOS) as a potential investment for those interested in the cannabis sector, particularly U.S.-based multi-state operators (MSOs). It highlights MSOS's recent outperformance compared to other cannabis ETFs, attributed to its focus on MSOs, and notes the speculative nature of the cannabis industry, despite recent positive developments like marijuana reclassification. The author suggests limited exposure for investors with high-risk capital and a long-term outlook.

title: Trump says USMCA ‘irrelevant’ for U.S. during Ford Motor factory tour
summary: During a factory tour at Ford, former U.S. President Donald Trump declared the USMCA trade agreement "irrelevant" for the United States, suggesting Canada was the only country that truly wanted it. Despite his claims, major automakers, including Ford, Tesla, and Toyota, have previously urged the Trump administration to extend USMCA, highlighting its crucial role in American auto production and the integrated North American supply chains. Trump reiterated his focus on bringing manufacturing back to the U.S., stating a preference for domestically made cars over those produced in Canada or Mexico.

title: Tesla Targets Europe's Value Buyers With New Long Range Model Y
summary: Tesla has launched a new Model Y Standard Long Range RWD in Europe, aiming for cost-conscious buyers seeking a spacious, efficient EV. This variant offers a WLTP range of 657 km and is hardware-ready for Full Self-Driving (FSD) due to the inclusion of Tesla’s AI4 computer. The move positions Tesla competitively in the European EV market, addressing demand for affordable, long-range electric SUVs amidst competition from Hyundai and XPeng.

title: Ford Motor (NYSE:F) Given New $12.80 Price Target at HSBC
summary: HSBC has increased its price target for Ford Motor (NYSE:F) from $9.80 to $12.80, maintaining a "hold" rating, but this new target still suggests an 8.41% potential downside from the stock's previous close. Despite varied analyst opinions with a consensus "Hold" rating and an average price target of $12.55, Ford recently beat its Q3 earnings estimates. The company also shows positive sentiment from Zacks regarding strong earnings-surprise history, inclusion in a top income stocks list, and CEO praise from Jim Cramer, alongside significant institutional investment activity.

title: Bitcoin hoard pushes Strive past Tesla into top 11 corporate holders
summary: Strive (Nasdaq: ASST) announced shareholder approval for an all-stock acquisition of Semler Scientific (Nasdaq: SMLR), which will add Semler's 5,048.1 Bitcoin to Strive's treasury. Combined with a separate purchase of 123 Bitcoin, Strive's total holdings will reach 12,797.9 Bitcoin, making it the 11th largest corporate holder, surpassing Tesla and Trump Media. Strive also plans to monetize Semler's operating business to retire legacy debt and will undertake a 1-for-20 reverse stock split.

title: Crane Co stock hits all-time high at 205.92 USD
summary: Crane Co's stock recently achieved an all-time high of $205.92 USD, reflecting strong investor confidence and a 34.6% increase over the past year. Despite appearing overvalued by Fair Value models, the company boasts strong financial health, a 55-year history of dividend payments, and recently exceeded Q3 2025 earnings expectations. Analysts see potential for further upside, with Wolfe Research initiating Outperform coverage.

title: Baron’s Big Bet on SpaceX
summary: Ron Baron's Baron Partners Fund (BPTRX) continues to deliver exceptional returns despite an increasingly concentrated and unorthodox portfolio. The fund's substantial holdings in SpaceX, now comprising 32% of net assets, along with a prior extreme concentration in Tesla, highlight a high-risk, high-reward strategy. While the fund has an impressive long-term track record, its extreme concentration makes it unsuitable for most investors, though a potential SpaceX IPO in 2026 could bring further changes.

title: Why Is Honda Changing Its Iconic Logo After All These Years?
summary: Honda is changing its iconic "H" logo for the first time in 25 years, effective 2027, to mark the company's "second founding" and reflect its commitment to next-generation electric vehicles (EVs), including the Honda 0 Series. The company describes this as an effort to "create new EVs from ‘zero’" and pursue new challenges in mobility. The new logo will appear on upcoming EVs, hybrid-electric models, dealerships, and in motorsports.

title: XPeng Bets On Local Supply Chains To Fuel Next Phase Of Global Growth
summary: XPeng Inc. announced it will establish independent supply chain teams in Europe and Southeast Asia by 2026 to localize operations and meet accelerating overseas demand. This strategic move aims to expedite procurement, reduce logistics friction, enhance flexibility, and ultimately cut costs by sourcing closer to production hubs in Malaysia and Austria. The company, which saw a 96% increase in overseas deliveries in 2025 across approximately 60 countries, anticipates global markets contributing nearly half of its sales within the next decade and is also integrating AI across its supply chain and expanding into robotics and flying cars.

title: Is General Motors Gaining Momentum in China's NEV Market?
summary: General Motors achieved record new energy vehicle (NEV) sales in China in 2025, with nearly 1 million units representing over half of its total deliveries and a 22.6% year-over-year increase. The company plans to introduce NEV variants for all new product launches starting in 2026, leveraging its diverse current NEV portfolio and strong performances from brands like Buick, Cadillac, Wuling, and Baojun. Despite GM's growth, competitors Tesla and BYD experienced a decline in their China sales for 2025.

title: Is General Motors Gaining Momentum in China's NEV Market?
summary: General Motors' new energy vehicle (NEV) sales in China reached nearly 1 million units in 2025, comprising over half of its total deliveries in the market and marking record levels for NEV volumes and penetration. The company saw a 2.3% year-over-year increase in combined deliveries and a 22.6% rise in NEV sales, driven by diversified offerings and strong performances from brands like Buick, Cadillac, and Wuling. Despite strong performance from GM, competitors like Tesla and BYD experienced slight decreases in their China sales for the same period.

title: Apple stock today: Creator Studio debut and Gemini Siri deal keep AAPL in play ahead of earnings
summary: Apple shares saw minimal movement following the launch of its new Creator Studio subscription bundle, as investors weigh the company's shift towards services and a significant AI deal with Google. The market is now focused on Apple's upcoming January 29 earnings report for insights into iPhone sales and the rollout progress of its AI initiatives. This service-focused strategy, including the Creator Studio and an enhanced Siri powered by Google's Gemini, aims to sustain revenue growth amidst varying hardware demand and increasing regulatory scrutiny.

title: U.S. Auto Industry 2025 Review and What to Expect in 2026
summary: The U.S. auto industry had a surprisingly strong 2025 despite high vehicle prices and rising financing costs, with total sales increasing by 2% to 16.2 million units. General Motors, Toyota, and Ford were top sellers, while Tesla struggled with a delivery decline and legacy automakers adjusted their EV strategies due to cooling demand. For 2026, the industry anticipates a slight sales drop to 15.8 million units but remains focused on strategic positioning amid factors like inflation, interest rates, and evolving government policies, with AI set to play a transformative role.

title: Applied Materials, Inc. $AMAT Stock Holdings Lifted by S Bank Fund Management Ltd
summary: S Bank Fund Management Ltd increased its stake in Applied Materials, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMAT) by 20% in the third quarter, now owning 24,000 shares valued at $4.91 million. Other institutional investors also significantly modified their holdings, contributing to institutional ownership hitting 80.56%. title: Tradr 2X Short TSLA Daily ETF (NASDAQ:TSLQ) Trading Down 1.6% – Here’s What Happened
summary: Tradr 2X Short TSLA Daily ETF (TSLQ) saw its stock price drop by 1.6% on Monday, trading as low as $17.61. title: Winthrop Advisory Group LLC Has $4.24 Million Stock Position in Tesla, Inc. $TSLA
summary: Winthrop Advisory Group LLC increased its stake in Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) by 14.2% in the third quarter, bringing its total holding to 9,534 shares valued at $4.24 million. The article notes recent insider selling by Kimbal Musk and CFO Vaibhav Taneja, totaling over $53 million, although insiders still own about 19.9% of the company. Despite the positive news of beating revenue estimates, Tesla faces high valuation metrics, a "Hold" consensus rating, and a target price below its current share price.

title: Cloudastructure founder Bentley sells $43,250 in shares By Investing.com
summary: Cloudastructure (NASDAQ:CSAI) founder Sheldon Richard Bentley sold 50,000 shares of Class A Common Stock for a total of $43,250 on January 13 and 14, 2026. These sales were executed under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan and occurred amidst significant stock volatility, which has seen a over 97% decline in the past year. Despite the stock performance, InvestingPro analysis suggests the company is undervalued and holds more cash than debt, maintaining a "FAIR" financial health score, with recent developments including a new security enclosure launch, patent for AI video surveillance, and a global guard center opening.

title: Tango Therapeutics stock maintains Buy rating at Stifel on encouraging early data
summary: Stifel has maintained its Buy rating and $15.00 price target on Tango Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ:TNGX) after the company provided pipeline updates and strategic priorities for 2026. This positive outlook is supported by "encouraging" early efficacy data for vopimetostat in combination with RAS(ON) inhibitor, with Stifel anticipating a swift move into a Phase 3 study. Despite positive market sentiment and significant stock returns, InvestingPro analysis indicates the stock is trading above its Fair Value.

title: Most consumers don't prefer an EV as their next vehicle, survey says
summary: A recent Deloitte survey indicates that electric vehicles (EVs) are not the top choice for consumers in the U.S. when considering their next car purchase, with only 7% preferring a battery EV. The survey also found that American buyers are less enthusiastic about software-driven vehicle features compared to other countries. Key concerns for consumers include limited driving range, charging time, price, and lack of infrastructure, while a good deal, quality, and performance remain primary drivers for brand choice.

title: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Group Inc. Has $147.22 Million Stock Position in General Motors Company $GM
summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Group Inc. increased its stake in General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) by 7.1% in the third quarter, now owning 2,414,597 shares valued at $147.22 million. Despite this institutional confidence and a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating from analysts, GM is facing near-term challenges due to multi-billion-dollar write-downs related to its EV strategy. Insider selling has also occurred, with key executives offloading a significant number of shares recently.

title: Tesla’s profit engine is sputtering. Elon Musk has bet its future on a promise he’s far from delivering
summary: Tesla's revenue from electric vehicle sales is declining, making the success of its robotaxi service crucial for the company's future. Despite CEO Elon Musk's ambitious promises, the robotaxi service is far from fully autonomous and is available in only two locations, with employees present in the cars. Critics argue that Musk's promises are unrealistic, especially given fierce competition and safety investigations into Tesla's autonomous driving features, potentially leading to a "reckoning" for the company.

title: MASTERINVEST Kapitalanlage GmbH Purchases 4,795 Shares of Tesla, Inc. $TSLA
summary: MASTERINVEST Kapitalanlage GmbH increased its stake in Tesla by 22.9%, acquiring an additional 4,795 shares to hold a total of 25,762 shares valued at $11.46 million. Despite Tesla reporting strong Q3 earnings with $0.50 EPS and $28.10 billion in revenue, insider selling has been observed, and analysts maintain a consensus "Hold" rating with an average price target of $408.54. The article also highlights mixed sentiment from analysts regarding Tesla's future performance and ongoing legal challenges.

title: Public policy could "shape" markets this year, Raymond James says. Here’s why.
summary: Raymond James analysts anticipate that public policy developments will significantly influence financial markets in 2026, driven by global geopolitical, market, and regulatory environments. Key themes include the U.S.-China relationship focusing on stability rather than breakthroughs, the U.S. conceptualizing AI as a strategic asset, and a more accommodating antitrust review for mergers and acquisitions compared to the previous administration. The report also forecasts a robust M&A environment for banks, building on increased activity in the previous year.

title: U.S. Vehicle Brand Loyalty Climbs to Five-Year High in 2025, According to LexisNexis Risk Solutions
summary: U.S. vehicle brand loyalty reached a five-year high in 2025, holding steady at 51.4%, despite challenges such as higher vehicle prices, expanding EV options, and shifting fuel incentives. Toyota led in brand loyalty with 60.2%, while Tesla's loyalty softened due to increased EV competition. The study by LexisNexis Risk Solutions highlights the resilience of brand affinity and the evolving purchasing behaviors of U.S. consumers.

title: KLA stock rating upgraded to Buy at TD Cowen on foundry growth outlook
summary: TD Cowen upgraded KLA Corporation's stock rating from Hold to Buy, significantly increasing the price target to $1,800.00 due to a strong outlook for leading-edge foundry spending in the semiconductor equipment market. The firm projects a 20% CAGR for this segment, driven by companies like TSMC and Samsung, positioning KLA favorably despite its high P/E ratio. KLA Corporation has shown strong financial health with impressive revenue growth and consistent dividend payments.

title: Gary Black Cites Steve Jobs, Stephen King To Reiterate Importance Of Marketing For Tesla: 'FSD Has A Take Rate Of Just 15%…'
summary: Investor Gary Black emphasized the critical need for a strong marketing strategy for Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA), citing the low 15% adoption rate of its Full Self-Driving (FSD) technology despite advances. He referenced Steve Jobs on customer experience and Stephen King on brand value, arguing that even with great engineering and a shift towards AI, products don't sell themselves. Black believes Tesla needs to invest in brand equity and marketing to increase its intrinsic value and stay competitive.

title: UBS Group AG Exits Substantial Shareholder Position in Aeris Resources
summary: UBS Group AG has ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Aeris Resources Limited as of January 9, 2026, according to a notice lodged under Australian regulations. This change signifies that UBS's aggregated voting power in Aeris has fallen below the substantial holder threshold, which could impact the company's institutional shareholder base. Aeris Resources is an Australian-listed company focused on mineral resource exploration and production, and its stock currently holds a "Buy" rating with a A$0.74 price target from analysts.

title: Tesla Tries A New Europe Fix: Cheaper, Longer-Range Model Y — Stock Rises Premarket
summary: Tesla has introduced a new, cheaper, longer-range Model Y variant in Europe, aiming to boost demand in a region where sales have been inconsistent. This new Standard Long Range trim offers approximately 350 miles of range at a lower price point than existing premium long-range options. The move comes as Tesla faced a challenging year in much of Europe, despite strong performance in Norway.

title: Ford Stock Rallies On Piper Sandler Upgrade, Plans To Launch Autonomous Driving On $30,000 EV
summary: Ford shares rallied after Piper Sandler upgraded the stock to 'Overweight' with a $16 price target, citing the company's next-generation EV platform and plans to introduce autonomous driving on lower-cost EVs. Ford aims to launch "eyes-off driving technology" on a $30,000 all-electric vehicle in 2028 and is focusing on more affordable EVs following a decision to scale back on larger, less profitable electric models. The company also unveiled the new Ford AI Assistant at CES 2026.

title: General Motors CEO Mary Barra says she still believes in electric vehicles
summary: General Motors CEO Mary Barra maintains her belief in electric vehicles despite the Trump administration eliminating EV tax credits, which cost GM $6 billion. She envisions a future where robust charging infrastructure and technological advancements, like AI and Google Gemini, make EVs more appealing and affordable to consumers. GM has also relocated its global headquarters to the historic Hudson's Detroit building to better suit its collaborative business structure.

title: Spence Asset Management trims Amazon.com stake by 3,667 shares
summary: Spence Asset Management, led by Eric Walton, has reduced its holdings in Amazon.Com, Inc. (AMZN) by 3,667 shares. This transaction comes as TipRanks’ AI Analyst, Spark, rates AMZN as "Outperform," citing strong financial performance and positive earnings sentiment in AWS and advertising, despite short-term technical weakness and a high P/E ratio.

title: GraniteShares YieldBOOST ETFs: A New Take on Income Generation
summary: GraniteShares has introduced YieldBOOST ETFs, designed to offer high distribution rates by selling put options on leveraged ETFs. These funds aim to maximize distributions for shareholders by capitalizing on the volatility of underlying assets like NVIDIA, Tesla, and Bitcoin, while not directly investing in the securities themselves. Key differentiators include using leveraged ETFs, providing downside protection by purchasing put options, and offering weekly income distributions through weekly FLEX options.

title: GM Vs Ford: Which Automaker is the Better Investment for 2026?
summary: This article analyzes whether General Motors (GM) or Ford (F) presents a better investment opportunity for 2026, considering their recent stock performance, EV sales, financial outlook, return on invested capital (ROIC), valuation, and dividends. While both companies outperformed expectations in 2025 and offer attractive valuations, GM shows an edge with higher ROIC, stronger earnings growth projections, and a "Strong Buy" Zacks Rank, compared to Ford's "Hold" rating.

title: Does WEX's (WEX) Embedded B2B Payments Push Mark a Shift in Its Core Investment Story?
summary: WEX is increasingly focusing on embedded B2B payments and integrating with technologies like the Tesla Supercharger network, shifting its investment narrative from traditional fuel cards to diversified digital payment flows. While this strategic pivot aims for growth and improves its earnings outlook, competitive pressures in the digital finance sector create varying fair value estimates among investors. The company projects significant revenue and earnings growth by 2028, supported by its move into embedded payments.

title: GM CEO Mary Barra tells automotive press she has 'no regrets' over EVs
summary: GM CEO Mary Barra stated she has "no regrets" regarding the company's approach to electric vehicles despite regulatory disruptions and significant special charges related to EV production plan changes. Barra emphasized a pragmatic path forward for GM's EV future, acknowledging that the transition might take longer without incentives and highlighting the company's self-help efforts to mitigate tariff impacts. GM reported a $7.6 billion loss from pivoting away from its initial EV production plans in 2025 but remains committed to an all-EV future.

title: Lululemon Raises Q4 Outlook on Strong Holiday Demand
summary: Lululemon Athletica has increased its Q4 2025 revenue and EPS outlook, now expecting figures at the high end of previous guidance due to strong holiday season performance.
